objective: nonadditive two-port transcript-language entropy under quotient transfer

port_cost.horizon_T: log2 cardinality of the realized safe port transcript language
port_cost.rate: limsup of horizon cost divided by T

causal_factor.port_compatibility: each target port transcript has a registered source port transcript image
causal_factor.fiber: M_i(T) is the maximum target-language preimage count for port i
causal_factor.directions: separate maps and fiber profiles are required in each direction

transfer.exactness: subexponential fibers in both directions preserve the full region

boundary.clone: m_i choices per step give M_i(T)=m_i^T and sharp shift log2 m_i
boundary.finite_state: a finite one-class quotient need not have subexponential history fibers
boundary.sparse: unbounded polynomial fibers can have zero fiber entropy

nonclaims: arbitrary transcript-tree functionals without a registered distortion modulus
quotient existence for arbitrary nonlinear systems
